title: Correcting Flows with Marginal Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.23134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching models, ODE-based generative models, generate samples by gradually morphing a simple source distribution into a target distribution. However, these models still face challenges in optimally balancing computational efficiency with generation fidelity. While predictor-corrector schemes have been proven to help address this issue in diffusion models effectively, their application to flow matching models remains under-explored. In this work we present a novel training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching, which exploits the fact that the ODE can be easily reversed. Our key idea, termed Marginal Matching, is to correct samples at a particular time step in the forward ODE towards a matching marginal distribution of the backward ODE. This scheme proves to reduce a bound on the distance between the data distribution and the learned distribution, motivating two different implementations for the correction function.

translated_title: 基于边际匹配的流校正
translated_abstract: 流匹配模型是一种基于ODE的生成模型，它通过将简单的源分布逐渐变形为目标分布来生成样本。然而，这些模型在最优地平衡计算效率与生成保真度方面仍面临挑战。虽然预测-校正方案已被证明能够有效解决扩散模型中的这一问题，但其在流匹配模型中的应用仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于训练的流匹配预测-校正框架，该框架利用了ODE可以轻松反向求解的特性。我们的核心思想被称为“边际匹配”，即在前向ODE的特定时间步处对样本进行校正，使其趋向于与反向ODE相匹配的边际分布。该方案被证明能够缩小数据分布与学习到的分布之间距离的上界，并由此激发了校正函数的两种不同实现方式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于训练的预测-校正框架，通过“边际匹配”思想在前向ODE的特定时间步将样本校正至与反向ODE相匹配的边际分布，从而有效缩小学习分布与数据分布之间的距离，提升流匹配模型的生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching, which uses Marginal Matching to correct samples at specific forward ODE timesteps towards the matching marginal distribution of the backward ODE, thereby reducing the distance between the learned and data distributions.
